{"diagnosis":"All 327 rows with source_tz='UTC' (batch 13) carry UTC timestamps, while every other batch is America/Chicago local time. The UTC batch starts at 12:00 where the Chicago batches start at 06:00, a 6-hour offset (CST in January). Its late-evening transactions therefore spill into 00:00-06:00 on the next date and are assigned to the wrong txn_date. The fix converts UTC rows to Chicago local time in silver_transactions, and the gold tables rebuild from it.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.85,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
WITH t AS (
  SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount,
         CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR
              ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts
  FROM raw_transactions
  WHERE status = 'POSTED'
)
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       local_ts AS txn_ts,
       CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM t;"}}
